content: [Static shot][Slow zoom in] A slow ominous wide shot of mist pouring over dark Carpathian ridges and beech forest, center-framed. No people. Then the attached reference image — a full-frame title card with teal brush-calligraphy Japanese lettering over a mountain backdrop — slams onto the screen with a fast zoom-in and fills the frame, exactly as it appears in the reference, and holds there to the end. Reproduce the reference lettering precisely, without altering or redrawing any characters. (bold heroic 1970s Japanese TV adventure brass fanfare over rolling timpani) <two sharp orchestral stabs, the second landing as the card hits> {Deep gravelly male Japanese narrator, over-the-top variety-show barker tone, restrained then exploding: 「しんじられる だろうか! でんせつの つけものいしが——うごいたッ! カルパチアに つたわる しんぴ! カメラは、ついに とらえたッ!」}
